name: Mental Abuse
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of distress and mental suffering, assuring that the Lord hears the cries of the righteous and delivers them from their troubles. Believers are reminded that in Christ Jesus there is no condemnation, offering freedom from the burden of guilt that can accompany mental affliction. Furthermore, Ephesians instructs caregivers, especially fathers, to nurture and admonish with patience and love, avoiding provocation that can lead to anger, highlighting the importance of godly guidance in preventing mental harm.
